newsitem.title: FINLAND: RESEARCH ALERT - Salomon affirms Merita buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Salomon affirms Merita buy.

text.p: Salomon Brothers said in a research note dated March 20 and received on Wednesday it had raised its forecasts for Finnish banking group Merita Oy's EPS for 1997-98, and that it reaffirmed its buy recommendation.

"Earnings momentum entering 1997 exceeded our earlier expectations," Salomon said. "We have increased our fully-taxed EPS estimates to 1.52 markka from 1.42 markka for 1997 and to 1.97 markka from 1.92 markka in 1998," it said.
"We have raised our price target to 22 markka and reaffirm our Buy recommendation," it said. At 1405/1205 GMT, Merita A traded at 17.20 markka, up 0.10. Its year-high is 19.50 markka.
